title: Render uppercase text from an ASCII art alphabet
summary: A terminal banner renderer receives uppercase text and a fixed-width ASCII alphabet grid. Select the correct glyph slice for each character and join the glyphs into the rendered banner. Render a word by taking fixed-width glyphs from an ASCII alphabet grid.
requirements: Rows contain 27 glyphs: A through Z then ? for unsupported characters.
Each glyph is width characters, and there are height rows.
Return an array containing one combined string per output row.
hints: For each output row, slice the corresponding glyph section for every character.
